mapper.sql: c.id AS comment_id, c.review_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.handle AS author_handle, u.profile_image AS author_profile_image
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( id, user_id, review_id, content ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{reviewId}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, review_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM comments WHERE id = #{commentId}

SELECT
FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{commentId}
